scheme_name: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Waiver of Electricity Duty
other_conditions: Tourism projects/units/expansion projects must be set up on or after 22 February 2021, or eligible hotel units that started commercial operation between 7 January 2015 and 31 December 2020 but could not apply earlier due to absence of a Bar in the Hotel
Units may belong to private, co‑operative, joint sectors or be companies/undertakings owned or managed by the State Government
Project must be covered by a detailed feasibility report/project prepared for the purpose
Project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank or State Financial Institution
Unit must hold a Registration Certificate, Date of Commencement Certificate and Eligibility Certificate issued by the West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation Limited
benefits_summary: Waiver of electricity duty on electricity consumed by the approved tourism project for five years from the date of commercial operation.
